d:
This is the final part of my special, "Professor of Tomfoolery."
The theme of the special is generational trauma, and the show culminates in a tribute to fathers.
I am two years late releasing this clip. I wrote this show in 2022 and filmed it in 2024, but I guess I’ve been focusing more on enjoying time with my 2-year-old daughter than on getting around to editing this.
I would love to know in the comments: what parts resonated with you the most?
